description: MSH3 pLoF burden in gnomAD v4 after removing exon 1 repeat artefacts, with per-ancestry Hardy-Weinberg prevalence predictions
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
q = """{ gene(gene_symbol:"MSH3", reference_genome:GRCh38){
  variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ variant_id consequence
    genome{ ac an } exome{ ac an populations{ id ac an } } } } }"""
v = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query":q}, timeout=240).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
LOF={"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant"}
recs=[]
for x in v:
    if x.get("consequence") not in LOF: continue
    pos=int(x["variant_id"].split("-")[1]); ac=an=0; pops={}
    for src in ("exome","genome"):
        d=x.get(src)
        if not d: continue
        ac+=d["ac"] or 0; an+=d["an"] or 0
        for p in (d.get("populations") or []):
            if p["id"] in ("XX","XY") or "_" in p["id"]: continue
            a,b = pops.get(p["id"],(0,0)); pops[p["id"]]=(a+(p["ac"] or 0), b+(p["an"] or 0))
    recs.append(dict(variant=x["variant_id"],pos=pos,csq=x["consequence"],ac=ac,an=an,
                     af=ac/an if an else 0, **{f"af_{k}": (a/b if b else 0) for k,(a,b) in pops.items()}))
L=pd.DataFrame(recs).fillna(0)

# Exon 1 of MSH3 (chr5:80,654,652-~80,655,000) carries a polymorphic 9-bp tandem repeat.
# Indels called there are repeat-length polymorphisms, not true loss of function.
rep = L.pos < 80655000
print("pLoF calls inside the exon 1 polymorphic 9-bp repeat:", rep.sum(),
      "| they carry %.1f%% of the total pLoF allele frequency" % (100*L[rep].af.sum()/L.af.sum()))
print(L[rep].sort_values("af",ascending=False)[["variant","csq","ac","af","af_afr","af_nfe"]].head(6)
      .to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda z:f"{z:.3e}"))

clean = L[~rep]
pops=[c[3:] for c in L.columns if c.startswith("af_")]
tab=pd.DataFrame({"q_cum":[clean["af_"+p].sum() for p in pops]}, index=pops)
tab["carrier_1_in"]=1/(2*tab.q_cum); tab["affected_per_million"]=tab.q_cum**2*1e6
tab=tab.sort_values("q_cum",ascending=False)
gq=clean.af.sum()
print(f"\nAfter removing the exon 1 repeat artefact: {len(clean)} pLoF variants, "
      f"global cumulative q = {gq:.2e}")
print(f"  carrier frequency 2q = {2*gq:.4f} (1 in {1/(2*gq):.0f})")
print(f"  predicted biallelic frequency q^2 = {gq**2:.2e} = {gq**2*1e6:.2f} per million "
      f"({gq**2*1e5:.3f} per 100 000)")
print("\nPer-ancestry (gnomAD v4 exomes):"); print(tab.round(7).to_string())
print("\nMost frequent single true pLoF allele AF = %.2e (no founder allele dominates)" % clean.af.max())
print("Median pLoF AF = %.2e; %d of %d are singletons (AC=1)" %
      (clean.af.median(), (clean.ac==1).sum(), len(clean)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))
cls=["Pathogenic","Likely\npathogenic","VUS","Likely\nbenign","Benign"]; n=[548,228,2996,1638,133]
ax[0].bar(cls,n,color=["#C44E52","#DD8452","#937860","#8C8C8C","#4C72B0"])
ax[0].set_ylabel("ClinVar records"); ax[0].set_title("MSH3 ClinVar: 53% of 5665 records\nare variants of uncertain significance")
for i,y in enumerate(n): ax[0].text(i,y+60,str(y),ha="center",fontsize=9)

d=clean.sort_values("af",ascending=False).head(50)
ax[1].semilogy(range(1,len(d)+1), d.af.values,"o-",ms=4,color="#4C72B0")
ax[1].axhline(1e-4,color="#C44E52",ls="--",lw=1.5,label="AF 0.01%")
ax[1].set_xlabel("pLoF variant rank"); ax[1].set_ylabel("Allele frequency (gnomAD v4)")
ax[1].set_title("Allelic heterogeneity: no founder allele,\nburden spread over rare private variants"); ax[1].legend(frameon=False)

t2=tab[tab.q_cum>0].sort_values("affected_per_million")
ax[2].barh(t2.index, t2.affected_per_million, color="#55A868")
ax[2].set_xlabel("Predicted biallelic carriers per million"); ax[2].set_ylabel("gnomAD ancestry group")
ax[2].set_title("Hardy-Weinberg prediction from MSH3\npLoF burden, by ancestry")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
